response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced full-stack and web software engineer with a strong track record in TypeScript, Node.js, and general software craftsmanship, but his background shows no evidence of SoC/IP modeling, hardware-software co-design, GPU/SIMD/MIMD architecture, deep-learning workload optimization, or performance architecture for AI accelerators — the core requirements of this Principal Performance Architect role. His experience is almost entirely in web/mobile/backend application development rather than hardware or chip-level performance engineering.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level software engineering experience across multiple domains
Strong low-latency systems experience (DLang, async I/O, high-throughput microservices at Dunnhumby)
Demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring, and open-source project ownership
concerns: No demonstrated experience with SoC/IP modeling or chip architecture
No evidence of GPU, SIMD/MIMD, or AI accelerator hardware optimization work
No background in deep-learning training/inference performance optimization

key_factors.factor: Lack of SoC/IP modeling and hardware architecture experience
No AI/deep-learning workload or GPU optimization background
Strong general software engineering seniority and craftsmanship
